name: Cape of Good Hope
locator: Cape of Good Hope row, Population column. The Canadian statistical year-book cross-check dates the estimate to 1899.
definition: Cape Colony in its historical legal extent, including Pondoland and annexed British Bechuanaland. The Bechuanaland Protectorate, Basutoland, Natal, the Orange Free State and the South African Republic are outside this scope. Mafeking and Walfish Bay remain part of the Cape scope. The opening map places their points on the South African Republic and German South West Africa polygons respectively. The source month and day are unknown. The difference from the 1904 census cannot isolate wartime migration.

name: Cape of Good Hope
locator: Introductory review, p. iii, Area, Population and Electors.
definition: December 1900 comparison for the Cape Colony. The register includes Griqualand West, the Native Territories and Pondoland. British Bechuanaland and Walfish Bay belong to the legal extent described for the same estimate in the contemporary cross-check. The reference day and estimation method are unknown.
